recuration.notes: Complete CDMpc recipe recovered from the cited base-medium reference (Price et al 2019, Additional file 2 Table S1). CDMpc is amino-acid-rich: nitrogen comes from all 20 amino acids, not from a bulk ammonium salt (ammonium appears only in trace ammonium molybdate). No selenium, tungsten, nickel, boron, added Na2S/sulfide, or yeast extract are present. Iron is supplied as Fe(II) (FeCl2), so the current-list 'Iron (Fe3+)' entry does not reflect the added form.
